kreuzberger.t1: It’s a restaurant specialized in Syrian food. It’s the primary channel by which the “Be an Angel” foundation supports and integrates refugees who come to Germany in search of asylum.
kreuzberger.t2: The new user experience increased online store sales by 60% compared to the previous experience.
kreuzberger.t3: An online purchase should be simple, safe and intuitive. If the user has a positive experience, they will surely return to the store and recommend it.
kreuzberger.t4: This online store allows the user to buy their food in 4 steps. Choose their dishes, capture their data, choose the payment method and order.
